raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Stacked on the Q replication PR #47180  (Q replication + project-before-merge), which is stacked on [#44322](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44322). With the query all-gather gone, the owned DSA DCP route spends its time in three places this PR goes after:

With the query all-gather gone, nothing on the owned DCP route couples one row to another until the merge. This PR spends that, making the row the unit of 
 - **who** computes it: each rank scores 1/W of the decode indexer rows
 - **what** computes it: owned slots packed per row into CSR for aiter's FP8 MLA asm kernel, [ROCm/aiter#6132](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6132)
 - **when** its partial is exchanged : prefill runs in row chunks, each chunk's a2a behind the next chunk's attention.

## Correctness

The a2a payload stays bf16 and no new quantization is added: the asm kernel reads the same FP8 query and FP8 KV the Triton kernel reads.

MI355X, `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4`, TP4/EP4 + DCP4, FP8 KV, MTP (EAGLE, 5 steps, 6 draft tokens), real draft acceptance. All columns were measured on the same day with the same scripts.

| check | #44322 (b8a0a1ac70) | Q replication PR | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| passkey 8K / 34K / 96K (3 depths each) | 3/3, 3/3, 3/3 | 3/3, 3/3, 3/3 | 3/3, 3/3, 3/3 |
| GSM8K (400 questions, few-shot) | 0.953 | 0.945 / 0.940 | 0.935 / 0.955 |
| GSM8K (1319 questions, few-shot) | 0.935 | 0.933 | 0.928 |
| MTP accept length (4 prompts x 400 tokens, greedy) | 3.23 | 3.26 | 3.20 |
| NLL, last 2K tokens of a 48K prompt | 1.232 | 1.236 / 1.227 | 1.235 / 1.227 |
| KV capacity (tokens) | 8.89M | 8.89M | 8.89M |

Two values are two runs on the same server: GSM8K 400 moves by up to ±0.02 between runs, NLL by about ±0.01.

Kernel tests (`test_dcp_owned_asm_hip.py`):
- The asm kernel is as close to an fp32 reference as the Triton kernel on the same FP8 inputs (both about 2% relative error, which comes from FP8 rounding inside both kernels), with matching base-2 LSE. Rows that own no slot come out zero, and CSR row slices reproduce the whole-batch result bit for bit.
- `build_dcp_csr` packs exactly the owned slots.
- A row slice of the packed top-k with `row_to_batch` selects the same keys as the whole batch.
- The row-chunked a2a pipeline equals one `dcp_a2a_lse_reduce` bit for bit, timed or not.
- The planner's split is no slower in its model than one chunk more or fewer, grows with the rows, and grows when the host cost per chunk drops. The planner measures on the first larger extend, plans once the measurement is settled, and does not retry a measurement that failed.

## Performance

**Fixed-length probes** on a 131K cached prefix, simulated AL 3.61:

| probe | #44322 | Q replication PR | this PR | vs. #44322 |

| extend 2K (TTFT) | 331 ms | 287 ms | 263 ms | −21% |
| extend 4.6K | 584 ms | 485 ms | 415 ms | −29% |
| extend 12K | 1267 ms | 1007 ms | 781 ms | −38% |
| extend 32K | 3509 ms | 2844 ms | 1954 ms | −44% |
| fresh 131K prefill | 12.87 s | 10.30 s | 6.71 s | −48% |
| decode, 16 users (tok/s/user) | 84.7 | 87.1 | 92.8 | +9.6% |
| decode, 24 users (tok/s/user) | 70.0 | 72.4 | 80.5 | +15.0% |

**InferenceX agentic replay**, TP4/EP4 + DCP4 with MTP (simulated AL 3.61), 1 h per point, same server arguments as the #44322 table. The #44322 rows are its "after" numbers.

#44322: 10/28/2026 commit b8a0a1ac70
| Conc | Config | P90 Interactivity (tok/s/user) | TPUT per Chip (tok/s/GPU) | Chip Cache Hit Rate | CPU Cache Hit Rate | Theoretical Cache Hit Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | #44322 | 41.19 | 17,196 | 96.7% | — | 97.0% |
| 16 | #44322+#47180 | 51.38 | 18,125 | 96.6% | — | 96.9% |
| 16 | this PR | **59.91** | **18,882** | 96.7% | — | 97.0% |
| 24 | #44322 | 31.32 | 23,416 | 96.8% | — | 97.3% |
| 24 | #44322+#47180 | 36.05 | 25,151 | 96.9% | — | 97.3% |
| 24 | this PR | **44.00** | **27,690** | 96.8% | — | 97.3% |
| 40 | #44322 | 16.79 | 24,740 | 95.5% | — | 97.0% |
| 40 | #44322+#47180 | 19.70 | 26,583 | 95.0% | — | 97.0% |
| 40 | this PR | **23.99** | **30,649** | 94.4% | — | 97.2% |
| 48 | #44322 | 2.56 | 10,774 | 82.6% | — | 96.1% |
| 48 | #44322+#47180 | 3.18 | 12,819 | 81.9% | — | 96.4% |
| 48 | this PR | **8.62** | **23,729** | 87.6% | — | 96.9% |

- Over the Q replication PR, P90 interactivity is 1.17–1.22x at c16–c40 and throughput per GPU 1.04–1.15x. Over #44322 that is 1.40–1.45x P90 and 1.10–1.24x throughput.
- At c16, DCP4 now beats TP4 without DCP (53.07 / 17,396 in the #44322 table) on both P90 and throughput, where #44322 was at 0.78x P90.
- At c48 the pool is still full, but prefill is fast enough that fewer prefixes get evicted before reuse (chip hit rate 82.6% → 87.6%): P90 is 3.4x and throughput per GPU 2.2x of #44322.

**Per commit**, with the measured chunk planner in the last commit. Fixed probes are the mean over the two GPU groups of the median of 4 reps. The groups agree within 1% on prefill and within 4% on decode. The agentic replay is c24 for 1 h, with the two groups running side by side.

| commit | extend 2K | extend 4.6K | extend 12K | extend 32K | fresh 131K | decode 24 users | c24 P90 interactivity | c24 TPUT/GPU | c24 P90 TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q replication PR | 291 ms | 489 ms | 1007 ms | 2840 ms | 10.26 s | 70.6 | 37.19 | 24,849 | 1.52 s |
| + decode indexer split | 290 ms | 486 ms | 1006 ms | 2836 ms | 10.27 s | 75.4 | 38.95 | 26,170 | 1.68 s |
| + asm sparse MLA | 269 ms | 443 ms | 888 ms | 2239 ms | 7.85 s | 79.5 | 42.83 | 27,527 | 1.37 s |
| + a2a pipeline | 265 ms | 421 ms | 796 ms | 1945 ms | 6.68 s | 80.5 | 43.74 | 27,795 | 1.19 s |

## Modifications

1. **Split the decode indexer rows across the DCP group** (`dsa_indexer.py`, `dsa_dcp.py`) 6724cd9f851b28fc57b092b6c14bd992faed2dc2
    - Every rank used to score every decode row. Now each rank scores 1/W of the rows, then the top-k is all-gathered.
    - The top-k is gathered as float32, so it takes the custom all-gather instead of NCCL (about 25 → 8 µs per layer).
2. **Run the owned sparse MLA on the aiter FP8 asm kernel** (`asm_sparse_mla_dcp.py`, `dsa_backend.py`, `dsa_dcp.py`, `forward_mla_rocm.py`) 9be9f5d62ce02828fea6aa38f445eb08fbcb8c19
    - The FP8 query is built in one fused step, and the owned KV slots are packed into a CSR once per top-k.
    - Used with FP8 KV, 64 heads, up to 32K rows, and an aiter that has the kernel ([ROCm/aiter#6132](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6132), already in the pinned aiter). Otherwise the Triton kernel runs as before.
3. **Pipeline the prefill a2a with the owned attention** (`comm.py`, `dsa_backend.py`, `dsa_dcp.py`, `forward_mla_rocm.py`, `dcp_kernels.py`) f6088a69bd53ec455ef68c0d83f8fbe2a0c64b56
    - Extend batches are attended in row chunks. Each chunk's a2a runs on a side stream while the next chunk is attended.
    - The chunk count is not hard-coded. `DcpA2aChunkPlanner` times the first large extend once, then picks the fastest split, the same on every rank: 1 chunk below about 2K rows, 4 at 6K, 11 at 32K.

Scope: nothing changes without `--dcp-size > 1`. Only the HIP + DSA `triton` path is touched; CUDA is not. No new environment variables or server arguments.

## Checklist

- [x] `pre-commit`
- [x] Kernel tests (`test_dcp_owned_asm_hip.py`, `test_dcp_qrep_hip.py`), and the existing DCP kernel/unit tests
- [x] GLM-5.2 DCP4 end-to-end sanity (passkey up to 96K, NLL)
- [x] GSM8K, this PR vs. #44322
- [x] Agentic replay at c16 / c24 / c40 / c48

@@ -0,0 +1,166 @@
+"""DCP owned-slot sparse MLA on the aiter fp8 qh64 non-persistent asm kernel.
+
+Each query row attends only the top-k slots this rank owns. The asm kernel
+takes CSR indices (no work metadata) and fp8 Q/KV at unit scale, and returns
+a natural-log LSE. A row that owns no slot gets a zero output and a -inf LSE.
+"""
+
+import functools
+import os
+from typing import Tuple
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# The fp32 split partials of the kernel are addressed with 32-bit offsets.
+ASM_MAX_ROWS = 32768
+# The shape the qh64 kernel is built for: 64 query heads over a 512 + 64 row.
+ASM_NUM_HEADS = 64
+ASM_KV_LORA_RANK = 512
+ASM_ROPE_DIM = 64
+# fp8 Q/KV, 64 query heads, non-persistent, qseqlen 1 (ROCm/aiter#6132).
+_ASM_KERNEL_ROW = f"fp8,fp8,{ASM_NUM_HEADS},0,1,0,1,0,0,"
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def asm_sparse_mla_dcp_available() -> bool:
+    try:
+        from aiter.jit.core import get_asm_dir
+
+        with open(os.path.join(get_asm_dir(), "mla", "mla_asm.csv")) as f:
+            return any(line.startswith(_ASM_KERNEL_ROW) for line in f)
+    except (ImportError, OSError):
+        return False
+
+
+def is_asm_q8(q_nope: torch.Tensor, q_rope: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``q_nope`` and ``q_rope`` are the two halves of one fp8
+    ``[q_nope | q_rope]`` row, the query ``asm_sparse_mla_dcp`` reads."""
+    return (
+        q_nope.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        and q_rope.data_ptr()
+        == q_nope.data_ptr() + q_nope.shape[2] * q_nope.element_size()
+        and q_rope.stride()[:2] == q_nope.stride()[:2]
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _dcp_csr_kernel(
+    page_table_ptr,
+    indptr_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    TOPK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    start = tl.load(indptr_ptr + row)
+    count = tl.load(indptr_ptr + row + 1) - start
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < count
+    vals = tl.load(page_table_ptr + row * TOPK + offs, mask=mask)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + start + offs, vals, mask=mask)

+def plan_pipeline_chunks(costs: List[float], rows: int) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
+    """The even row chunking whose modeled schedule finishes first."""
+    best = _even_chunks(rows, 1)
+    best_us = modeled_pipeline_us(costs, best)
+    host = costs[-1]

+        if n * host >= best_us:
+            # Issuing n chunks alone takes longer than the best schedule.
+            break
+        chunks = _even_chunks(rows, n)
+        us = modeled_pipeline_us(costs, chunks)

+            break
+        best, best_us = chunks, us

+class DcpA2aChunkPlanner:
+    """Row chunks for ``DcpA2aChunkPipeline`` from the measured cost of its stages.
+
+    Each stage of a chunk costs a fixed part plus a per-row part: attention,
+    projection and pack on the compute stream, the a2a on the side stream, the
+    combine back on the compute stream, and the host time to issue the chunk.
+    The planner times every layer of one prefill run as two unequal chunks and
+    takes the median over the layers after the first, which takes the
+    first-use costs. It then picks the chunk count whose modeled schedule
+    finishes first; one chunk means no pipeline. A prefill larger than the
+    measured one is measured again, so the per-row costs come from where they
+    dominate.
+
+    Every DCP rank must plan the same chunks, so the ranks agree on each cost:
+    the slowest rank's compute, combine and host time, and the fastest rank's
+    a2a, which on the others also holds the wait for the last rank to arrive.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, cp_group: GroupCoordinator):
+        self.cp_group = cp_group
+        self.costs: Optional[List[float]] = None
+        self.measured_rows = 0
+        self._measuring: List[Tuple[int, DcpA2aChunkPipeline]] = []
+        self._num_chunks: Dict[int, int] = {}
+
+    def settle(self, layer_id: int) -> None:
+        """Take the costs measured from ``layer_id`` on in an earlier forward."""
+        if not self._measuring or self._measuring[0][0] != layer_id:
+            return
+        rows = self._measuring[0][1].rows
+        measured = [p for _, p in self._measuring[1:] if p.consumed]
+        self._measuring = []
+        # Not measured again at these rows, whether or not it took.
+        self.measured_rows = rows
+        if not measured:
+            return
+        costs = torch.tensor(
+            _median_costs([p.timing for p in measured], measured[0].chunks)
+        )
+        a2a = slice(2, 4)
+        if self.cp_group.world_size > 1:
+            costs[a2a] = -costs[a2a]
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(
+                costs, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MAX, group=self.cp_group.cpu_group
+            )
+            costs[a2a] = -costs[a2a]
+        self.costs = costs.tolist()
+        self._num_chunks.clear()
+
+    def pipeline(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        rows: int,
+        project: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
+        is_lse_base_on_e: bool,
+    ) -> Optional[DcpA2aChunkPipeline]:
+        if self._measuring:
+            measuring = self._measuring[0][1].rows == rows
+        else:
+            # Two chunks of at least one row each and unequal size.
+            measuring = rows > self.measured_rows and rows >= 3
+        if measuring:
+            # Two chunks, one twice the other: the fixed and per-row costs
+            # separate, and neither chunk includes the attention set-up.
+            pipeline = DcpA2aChunkPipeline(
+                [(0, rows // 3), (rows // 3, rows)],
+                self.cp_group,
+                project,
+                is_lse_base_on_e,
+                timed=True,
+            )
+            self._measuring.append((layer_id, pipeline))
+            return pipeline
+        if self.costs is None or rows < 2:
+            return None
+        n = self._num_chunks.get(rows)
+        if n is None:
+            n = len(plan_pipeline_chunks(self.costs, rows))
+            self._num_chunks[rows] = n
+        if n == 1:
+            return None
+        return DcpA2aChunkPipeline(
+            _even_chunks(rows, n), self.cp_group, project, is_lse_base_on_e
+        )

+        sel = kvf[local[t, : counts[t]].long()]
+        s = qf[t] @ sel.T * sm_scale
+        exact_lse[t] = torch.logsumexp(s, -1)
+        exact_out[t] = torch.softmax(s, -1) @ sel[:, :KV_LORA_RANK]
+    asm_err = _rel_err(out[owned], exact_out[owned])
+    triton_err = _rel_err(triton_out[owned], exact_out[owned])
+    assert asm_err < 1.1 * triton_err + 1e-3, (asm_err, triton_err)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(lse[owned], exact_lse[owned], rtol=0, atol=1e-2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        triton_lse[owned], exact_lse[owned] / math.log(2), rtol=0, atol=1e-2
+    )
+    # A row that owns no slot drops out of the merge with another rank's row.
+    assert counts[0] == 0
+    assert out[0].eq(0).all() and lse[0].eq(float("-inf")).all()
+    other_out = torch.randn(1, H, KV_LORA_RANK, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    other_lse = torch.randn(1, H, device="cuda")
+    merged, _ = dcp_lse_combine_triton(
+        torch.stack([out[:1], other_out]),
+        torch.stack([lse[:1], other_lse]),
+        is_lse_base_on_e=True,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(merged, other_out, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    # Row chunks of the batch read their slice of the same CSR.
+    lo, hi = T // 3, T
+    out_c, lse_c = asm_sparse_mla_dcp(
+        q8[lo:hi].contiguous(),
+        kv,
+        indptr[lo : hi + 1],
+        indices,
+        sm_scale,
+        KV_LORA_RANK,
+        one,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out_c, out[lo:hi], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(lse_c, lse[lo:hi], rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+def _rope_interleaved(x, cos, sin):
+    x0, x1 = x[..., 0::2].float(), x[..., 1::2].float()
+    c, s = cos[:, None].float(), sin[:, None].float()
+    return torch.stack([x0 * c - x1 * s, x1 * c + x0 * s], -1).flatten(-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("T,rank", [(24, 0), (144, 1), (2304, 3)])
+def test_fused_rope_cat_and_cache_matches_dcp_write(T, rank, monkeypatch):
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from aiter.ops.triton.fusions.fused_kv_cache import (
+        fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla,
+    )
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.mla_buffer import (
+        set_mla_kv_buffer_triton_fp8_quant,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.attention_forward_methods import (
+        forward_mla_rocm,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(4)
+    rows, max_pos = 4096, 65536
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        forward_mla_rocm,
+        "get_parallel",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(attn_dcp_size=DCP, attn_dcp_rank=rank),
+    )
+    # Distinct widened slots, slot 0 (the reserved padding slot) among them.
+    loc = torch.randperm(rows * DCP, device="cuda")[:T]
+    loc[T // 2] = 0
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(out_cache_loc=loc)
+    owned_loc = forward_mla_rocm._dcp_owned_cache_loc(batch)
+    assert forward_mla_rocm._dcp_owned_cache_loc(batch) is owned_loc
+
+    positions = torch.randint(0, max_pos, (T,), device="cuda")
+    freqs = torch.rand(max_pos, ROPE_DIM // 2, device="cuda") * 6.3
+    cos, sin = freqs.cos().bfloat16(), freqs.sin().bfloat16()
+    q_nope = torch.randn(T, H, KV_LORA_RANK, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    q_pe = torch.randn(T, H, ROPE_DIM, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    k_nope = torch.randn(T, 1, KV_LORA_RANK, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    k_pe = torch.randn(T, 1, ROPE_DIM, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+
+    kv = torch.zeros(rows, 1, KV_LORA_RANK + ROPE_DIM, device="cuda", dtype=FP8)
+    q8, *_ = fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla(
+        q_nope,
+        q_pe,
+        k_nope,
+        k_pe,
+        kv,
+        owned_loc,
+        positions,
+        cos,
+        sin,
+        None,
+        False,
+        apply_scale=False,
+        q_out_dtype=FP8,
+    )
+
+    c, s = cos[positions], sin[positions]
+    ref_q = torch.cat([q_nope.float(), _rope_interleaved(q_pe, c, s)], -1)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        q8.float(), ref_q.to(FP8).float(), rtol=FP8_RTOL, atol=FP8_ATOL
+    )
+    ref_kv = torch.zeros_like(kv)
+    set_mla_kv_buffer_triton_fp8_quant(
+        ref_kv,
+        loc,
+        k_nope,
+        _rope_interleaved(k_pe, c, s).bfloat16(),
+        FP8,
+        dcp_world_size=DCP,
+        dcp_rank=rank,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        kv[..., :KV_LORA_RANK].float(),
+        ref_kv[..., :KV_LORA_RANK].float(),
+        rtol=0,
+        atol=0,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(kv.float(), ref_kv.float(), rtol=FP8_RTOL, atol=FP8_ATOL)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [24, 144])
+def test_packed_topk_row_slice_matches_whole_batch(rows):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.topk import topk_transform_packed_v2
+
+    torch.manual_seed(2)
+    page_size, max_len = 64, 16384
+    lengths = torch.randint(
+        TOPK // 2, max_len, (rows,), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    pages = max_len // page_size
+    page_table = torch.stack(
+        [torch.randperm(4 * pages, device="cuda")[:pages] for _ in range(rows)]
+    ).int()
+    scores = torch.randn(rows, max_len, device="cuda")
+
+    whole = torch.empty(rows, TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    all_rows = torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    topk_transform_packed_v2(
+        scores.clone(),
+        lengths,
+        page_table,
+        whole,
+        page_size,
+        row_starts=torch.zeros_like(all_rows),
+        row_to_batch=all_rows,
+    )
+
+    per = -(-rows // DCP)
+    split = torch.empty(per * DCP, TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    for rank in range(DCP):
+        lo, hi = min(rank * per, rows), min(rank * per + per, rows)
+        if hi == lo:
+            continue
+        row_ids = torch.arange(lo, hi, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        topk_transform_packed_v2(
+            scores[lo:hi].clone(),
+            lengths[lo:hi],
+            page_table,
+            split[rank * per : rank * per + hi - lo],
+            page_size,
+            row_starts=torch.zeros_like(row_ids),
+            row_to_batch=row_ids,
+        )
+
+    # The top-k order within a row is unspecified; the selected set is not.
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        split[:rows].sort(-1).values, whole.sort(-1).values, rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+    # Each selected slot is the page-table translation of one of the row's top-k.
+    for r in (0, rows - 1):
+        n = lengths[r].item()
+        pos = torch.topk(scores[r, :n], TOPK).indices
+        expect = page_table[r, pos // page_size] * page_size + pos % page_size
+        assert set(whole[r].tolist()) == set(expect.int().tolist())
+
+
+def _mock_group(world_size: int):
+    group = MagicMock()
+    group.world_size = world_size
+    group.all_to_all_single = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda out, inp: out.copy_(inp))
+    return group
+
+
+def _partials(rows: int, D: int):
+    partial = torch.randn(rows, H, KV_LORA_RANK, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    lse = torch.randn(rows, H, device="cuda") * 3
+    w_vc = (torch.randn(H, KV_LORA_RANK, D, device="cuda") * 0.04).bfloat16()
+
+    def project(x):
+        return torch.bmm(x.transpose(0, 1), w_vc).transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+
+    def attend(lo, hi):
+        return partial[lo:hi], lse[lo:hi].contiguous()
+
+    return partial, lse, project, attend
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows,chunk", [(4096, 1024), (5000, 1250), (300, 128)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("timed", [False, True])
+def test_a2a_chunk_pipeline_matches_reduce(rows, chunk, timed):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.dcp import DcpA2aChunkPipeline, dcp_a2a_lse_reduce
+
+    torch.manual_seed(3)
+    N, D = 2, 256
+    group = _mock_group(N)
+    partial, lse, project, attend = _partials(rows, D)
+    chunks = [(lo, min(rows, lo + chunk)) for lo in range(0, rows, chunk)]
+
+    # Project per chunk for the reference too: bmm rounding depends on the batch.
+    projected = torch.cat([project(partial[lo:hi]) for lo, hi in chunks])
+    ref = dcp_a2a_lse_reduce(projected, lse, group, is_lse_base_on_e=False)
+
+    pipe = DcpA2aChunkPipeline(chunks, group, project, False, timed=timed)
+    out = pipe.run(attend)
+
+    assert pipe.consumed and pipe.rows == rows
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    sizes = [hi - lo for lo, hi in chunks]
+    if timed and sizes[0] != sizes[-1]:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.dcp.comm import _median_costs
+
+        costs = _median_costs([pipe.timing], chunks)
+        assert len(costs) == 7 and min(costs) >= 0 and costs[-1] > 0
+
+
+# Stage costs (us): compute, a2a and combine as (fixed, per row), then the host
+# time per chunk, in the range measured at GLM-5.2 DCP4 shapes on MI355X.
+_COSTS = [20.0, 0.11, 33.0, 0.152, 10.0, 0.038, 240.0]
+
+
+def test_plan_pipeline_chunks_follows_costs():
+    from sglang.srt.layers.dcp.comm import modeled_pipeline_us, plan_pipeline_chunks
+
+    plans = {rows: plan_pipeline_chunks(_COSTS, rows) for rows in (512, 4096, 32768)}
+    for rows, chunks in plans.items():
+        assert chunks[0][0] == 0 and chunks[-1][1] == rows
+        assert all(a[1] == b[0] for a, b in zip(chunks, chunks[1:]))
+        # No even chunking with one chunk more or less models faster.
+        n = len(chunks)
+        for m in (n - 1, n + 1):
+            if 1 <= m <= rows:
+                per = -(-rows // m)
+                other = [(lo, min(rows, lo + per)) for lo in range(0, rows, per)]
+                assert modeled_pipeline_us(_COSTS, other) >= modeled_pipeline_us(
+                    _COSTS, chunks
+                )
+    # Issuing a chunk costs more than a small batch's exchange hides: no split.
+    assert len(plans[512]) == 1
+    # The hidden compute grows with the rows, the per-chunk cost does not.
+    assert 1 < len(plans[4096]) < len(plans[32768])
+    # Free per-chunk costs leave nothing to stop the split but the host.
+    cheap = _COSTS[:-1] + [_COSTS[-1] / 8]
+    assert len(plan_pipeline_chunks(cheap, 4096)) > len(plans[4096])
+
+
+def test_planner_measures_then_plans():
+    from sglang.srt.layers.dcp import DcpA2aChunkPlanner
+    from sglang.srt.layers.dcp.comm import plan_pipeline_chunks
+
+    torch.manual_seed(5)
+    rows, D = 3000, 256
+    group = _mock_group(1)
+    _, _, project, attend = _partials(2 * rows, D)
+    planner = DcpA2aChunkPlanner(group)
+
+    # The first prefill measures on every layer it reaches with those rows.
+    for layer in range(3):
+        p = planner.pipeline(layer, rows, project, False)
+        assert p is not None and p.timing is not None
+        assert len(p.chunks) == 2 and p.chunks[-1][1] == rows
+        p.run(attend)
+    assert planner.pipeline(3, rows // 2, project, False) is None
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    # A later forward reaching the first of them takes the costs.
+    planner.settle(1)
+    assert planner.costs is None
+    planner.settle(0)
+    assert planner.measured_rows == rows and min(planner.costs) >= 0
+    want = plan_pipeline_chunks(planner.costs, rows)
+    got = planner.pipeline(0, rows, project, False)
+    assert (got.chunks if got is not None else [(0, rows)]) == want
+    assert got is None or got.timing is None
+
+    # A larger prefill is measured again.
+    again = planner.pipeline(0, 2 * rows, project, False)
+    assert again.timing is not None
+    # One that never reached a second layer keeps the costs, and is not retried.
+    costs = list(planner.costs)
+    planner.settle(0)
+    assert planner.costs == costs and planner.measured_rows == 2 * rows
+    retry = planner.pipeline(0, 2 * rows, project, False)
+    assert retry is None or retry.timing is None
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
